recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Revisit only if the work group reopens the later FHIR-34442 policy and decides to restore a date/mode restriction or rename the element in a future release.
issue_request: FHIR-13986 is a Published/Not Persuasive with Modification FHIR-core List issue raised for STU3. It asked to rename List.entry.date to List.entry.dateAdded to avoid using it as a deletion date; the final resolution instead added a constraint limiting entry dates to working lists and removed the usage note.
initial_application: No Jira-keyed FHIR-13986 git commit was found, though Jira records svn revision 13880. Historical List source carried the resulting lst-3 invariant, mode = 'working' or entry.date.empty(), and FHIR-17745 later corrected only the human text of that same invariant.
additional_context: FHIR-34442 is a later Published/Persuasive with Modification List decision that explicitly says FHIR-13986 did not consider the full use-case spectrum and resolves to drop both lst-2 and lst-3. FHIR-I March and May 2022 minutes cite FHIR-13986 as related background and record approval to remove lst-2/lst-3. The combined branch already contains separate reconciliation commits for FHIR-34442 and FHIR-17745.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current active List source has no lst-3 restriction, still defines List.entry.date as when the item was added to the list, and includes the later deleted-flag guidance. Restoring the old constraint or renaming the element would contradict later published WG intent.

related_jiras.note: Later Published List decision removed the lst-3 working-list constraint introduced for FHIR-13986 after considering broader use cases.
Technical correction to the human text of the same lst-3 invariant; already represented on the combined branch as a no-change audit.
Older Resolved - No Change discussion about tracking List entry deletion dates; it does not override the later FHIR-34442 removal of lst-2/lst-3.
